property: NewReno improves sender recovery using cumulative/partial ACK interpretation, while SACK adds explicit non-contiguous receive-block feedback; stacks may support both mechanisms rather than treating them as sequential TCP versions.

date_or_range.notes: Different recovery/feedback branches coexist in implementations and standards.

sources.supports: NewReno operates as a modification to Reno recovery
SACK adds explicit selective acknowledgement feedback

negative_claims: Do not draw Tahoe→Reno→NewReno→SACK as a release-version chain.
SACK does not mean 'the version after NewReno'.
open_questions: Document historical Linux fallback behavior when SACK is not negotiated.
